info.name: mosaicWave /api/v1
info.description:
Hand-written Postman collection for mosaicWave. Not a generated client.

**Import:** Postman → Import → `postman/mosaicwave.postman_collection.json` and an environment JSON from this folder. Create a Postman workspace if you want (File → New → Workspace); workspaces are not a file format.

**Auth:** `POST /auth/login` sets httponly cookie `mw_session`. The collection copies it into variable `mw_session` and sends `Cookie` on later requests. You can also use Postman’s cookie jar.

**Order that fills ids:** Login → List sources → List assets → List users. Then open thumb/file using `{{assetId}}` / `{{sourceId}}`. Share: owner **Set grants** with a member `userId` (`read` or `write`).

**Share:** `PUT /sources/{id}/grants` is the owner’s replacement list. Grantee keeps their own library and also sees the shared one. Admin has no bypass.

**Album sync:** Pull is `GET /sync/changes` (`since_rev`). Push is `/albums` with `base_rev` (the album `rev`, not `server_rev`). Folder **Sync replica** is create-`id`, membership `base_rev`, delete + tombstone pull. Do not POST the pull JSON back.

Hit FastAPI directly (`http://127.0.0.1:8000` debug, `:8090` MSI/QPKG), not the Next.js `:3000` proxy, unless you intend to test the rewrite.

**Backups (admin):** folder **Backups**. Start a site backup, poll the job in **Jobs**, then List backups saves `{{backupName}}` for Download / Delete. Restore: turn on maintenance, Stage restore (a job), poll it, then Apply restore (restarts the server) and read Restore state. `python -m mosaicwave.restore` still works offline.

**My library backup (any signed-in user):** folder **My library backups**. Back up my library starts a job; List my backups saves `{{libraryBackupName}}` for Download / Delete / Restore. Restore replaces only your own library while the server runs (a job; your previous library is deleted once the restore succeeds, so back up first).

**My exports (any signed-in user):** folder **My exports**. Export my photos starts a job that writes your photos as ordinary files (plain or Google Takeout layout, split into zips by size; a file bigger than the size is left unzipped beside them). List my exports saves `{{exportName}}` and `{{exportFile}}` for Download / Delete. An export is not a backup.

**Maintenance:** folder **Maintenance**. Status is public; Turn on/off need an admin session. While it is on, other users get `503 maintenance`.

OpenAPI at `{{baseUrl}}/docs` stays the living spec; this collection is a snapshot for manual tests.

Admin only. Starts a job (kind site_backup) and saves {{jobId}}; poll GET /jobs/{{jobId}}. 409 if another job is running. Archive lands in the app folder's backups/. include_thumbs adds thumbnails (can be regenerated). split_gb (0.0001 to 1024) writes a backup bigger than that as several zips, mosaicwave-site-<time>-001.zip, -002.zip and so on, which must stay together; empty is one zip.
Admin only. Newest first. Saves {{backupName}} from the first item.
Admin only. The zip contains password hashes and every user's originals; store it like the data folder. Use Send and Download in Postman.
Admin only. 404 backup_not_found if the name does not exist.

Admin only. Needs maintenance mode on (409 maintenance_required) and no running job (409 job_running; 409 restore_pending while a staged restore waits). Starts a job (kind site_restore, cancellable) that unpacks and checks the archive next to the live data; saves {{jobId}}. Nothing live changes until Apply.

Admin only. Body {path}: a site backup .zip anywhere on the server (a share, a USB drive); it is restored from there, nothing is copied. Same rules as Stage restore (maintenance_required, job_running, restore_pending). 400 backup_path_required, backup_not_a_file or backup_invalid (not a usable site backup) start no job. Saves {{jobId}}.

Admin only. Raw zip body (Send and Select File). Streamed to the app folder's backups/ and checked (manifest and zip index only); stored as mosaicwave-site-<time inside the archive>.zip and returned as listed. The same file twice is one archive; a different file with the same time gets the next free second. 400 backup_invalid (deleted), 413 upload_too_large, 507 backup_no_space, 409 restore_pending or job_running. A part of a split backup (…-NNN.zip) is stored under its own number: upload every part, in any order, then use Stage restore with the first part's name (400 backup_parts_missing lists what is not there). A big file of a split backup (…-NNN.big) is not a zip: send it with the query name set to its file name, after at least one zip of the same backup. The response lists the backup as one entry (parts, part_files, missing).

Admin only. pending is the staged restore waiting to be applied (archive, summary, upgrade). result is what the last start-up swap did (status done or error). The replaced data is deleted once the new data is in place, so kept is empty.

Admin only. Restarts the server; the staged restore is swapped in before anything opens. 409 restore_not_staged, maintenance_required or job_running. restarting is true when a restart was scheduled (a supervisor or start script must bring the API back). Sign in again afterwards if the session is refused, then Restore state shows the result.
Admin only. Throws a staged restore away and forgets the last result.

Any signed-in user. Starts a job (kind library_backup, cancellable; poll it in Jobs) that writes mosaicwave-library-<time>.zip (or -001.zip, -002.zip … when the optional body split_gb is smaller than the library; keep the parts together) under your own backups folder: your library database and originals, no thumbnails. 409 job_running while another job runs. Saves {{jobId}}.
Only your own archives, newest first. Saves {{libraryBackupName}} from the first item.
404 backup_not_found for a name that is not yours. Use Send and Download in Postman.
404 backup_not_found if the name does not exist in your folder.

Raw zip body (Send and Select File). Streamed to your backups folder and checked; stored as mosaicwave-library-<time inside the archive>.zip and returned as listed. 400 backup_wrong_kind (a site backup), backup_invalid, 413 upload_too_large, 507 backup_no_space, 409 job_running or restore_pending. The archive may come from another account; restoring remaps it to you.

item.name: Restore my library from a server path

request.description: Admin only (403 admin_only for members). Body {path}: a library backup .zip anywhere on the server; restored from there, nothing is copied. 400 backup_path_required, backup_not_a_file, backup_wrong_kind (a site backup) or backup_invalid start no job; 403 folder_not_allowed for a path under another user's library or archive folder. Then a library_restore job as for Restore my library. Saves {{jobId}}.

Replaces your library with the backup while the server runs: a job (kind library_restore) that unpacks and checks it, then swaps your database and originals (cancellable until the swap starts). Your previous library is deleted once the restore succeeds (back it up first); a failed restore changes nothing. Other users are not affected; your own requests get 503 library_restoring for a moment during the swap. 409 job_running or restore_pending. Saves {{jobId}}.

Any signed-in user. Starts a job (kind export, cancellable; poll it in Jobs) that writes your photos as ordinary files under your own exports folder. Body: all (whole library) or album_ids and/or asset_ids; layout plain or takeout (Google Takeout tree with .json sidecars); split_gb (empty for one zip) - a file bigger than that is not zipped but saved beside the zips. 400 export_nothing_selected, export_scope or export_empty, 404 album_not_found, 409 job_running. Saves {{jobId}}.
Same job for chosen albums (and/or photo ids). Needs {{albumId}} from List albums. A photo in an exported album is written once, into that album's folder. Saves {{jobId}}.
Only your own exports, newest first, each with layout, counts, size and files ({path, size, zipped}). Saves {{exportName}} and {{exportFile}} from the first export.
One zip part, or a file that was too big to zip. 404 export_not_found for a name or path that is not yours or not in the export. Use Send and Download in Postman.
Removes the whole export (every zip and unzipped file). 404 export_not_found if it is not yours.
Public (no sign-in). state is off, draining (on, but a job is still running) or on, with the reason and since. Works during maintenance, unlike most other requests.

Admin only. The one job running on the server, whoever started it: kind, owner, progress and start time, but no file names. This is the job maintenance mode waits for while the state is draining. 403 for members.

Admin only. While on, every other user and anonymous call gets 503 with code maintenance (and a Retry-After header); an admin keeps working. Sign-in is refused for non-admins. Run Turn maintenance off when done.
Admin only. Idempotent. The command line does the same without the API: python -m mosaicwave.maintenance off.
